description: Installation of a 20 metre monopole antenna mast, 12 apertures, equipment cabinets, the removal of the existing 11.7 metres monopole, three apertures, redundant equipment cabinets and development ancillary thereto.
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (5G and Future Technology Statement, 150 EXISTING ELEVATION A, 100 EXISTING SITE PLAN, 265 MAX CONFIGURATION ELEVATION, 215 MAX CONFIGURATION SITE PLAN, BEACONCOMMS Supplementary Information, Cover Letter: Received 30/08/2019. 
002 SITE LOCATION PLAN: Received 24/09/2019) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The structure, antenna, and associated facilities will be removed if they become obsolete.

Condition : 4 - Neither the footway or carriageway adjacent to the application site shall be reduced or blocked at any time during the construction or maintenance of the hereby approved development and all vehicles associated with the installation and maintenance of the hereby approved development shall only park/stop at permitted locations and within time periods permitted by the existing on-street restrictions.
